title: Business Platinum Rewards Card: New Customer First Year Fee Waiver
summary: This document covers the Business Platinum Rewards Card New Customer First-Year Fee Waiver promotion: offer runs 2025-11-01 to 2026-02-28, first-year annual fee is $0 for eligible new accounts, then the standard $450 annual fee applies after year one. The waiver appears on the account during the first year if opened in the promo window; upgrading/changing products only keeps the waiver if the account remains eligible, and the account must stay open and in good standing.
